claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Bemesetron is a selective 5-HT3 receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Bemesetron is a selective 5-HT3 receptor antagonist with no known cytotoxic activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
